mapper.select: SELECT p.project_name, p.start_date, p.end_date, p2.project_name AS parent_project_name FROM projects p LEFT JOIN projects p2 ON p.parent_project_id = p2.project_id WHERE p.project_id = #{id}

SELECT t.task_id, t.title, t.content, t.assignee_user_id, u.user_name AS assignee_user_name, c.code_name AS priority_name, t.progress_rate, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.actual_hours, t.estimated_hours, t.est_start_date, t.est_end_date, t.created_at, t.attachment_group_id, p.project_name, p.parent_project_id, p2.project_name AS parent_project_name, t2.type_name, t.task_status_id, t3.status_name, NVL((SELECT SUM(hours) FROM time_entries WHERE task_id = t.task_id), 0) AS total_time_entries FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN projects p2 ON p.parent_project_id = p2.project_id JOIN task_types t2 ON t.task_type_id = t2.task_type_id JOIN task_statuses t3 ON t.task_status_id = t3.task_status_id JOIN common_code c ON t.priority_code = c.code_value LEFT JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.task_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO time_entries( time_entry_id, task_id, user_id, work_date, hours, created_at, task_desc) VALUES (TIME_ENTRIES_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{workDate}, #{hours}, SYSDATE, #{taskDesc})
mapper.select: SELECT t.work_date, t.hours, t.created_at, t.task_desc, u.user_name FROM time_entries t JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM (SELECT time_entry_id FROM time_entries WHERE task_id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_logs(activity_log_id, target_type, target_id, action_type, actor_user_id, before_value, after_value, created_at) VALUES (ACTIVITY_LOGS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 'time_entries', #{targetId}, 'J1', #{actorUserId}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT ROWNUM AS idx ,A.* FROM( SELECT t.created_at, a.before_value, a.after_value, a.action_type, u.user_name, a.target_type, t.task_desc FROM activity_logs a JOIN time_entries t ON a.target_id = t.time_entry_id JOIN users u ON a.actor_user_id = u.user_id WHERE target_type = 'time_entries' AND t.task_id = #{id} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) A
SELECT task_type_id, type_name FROM task_types WHERE is_active = 'O1'

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS user_id, u.user_name AS user_name, r.role_name AS user_type FROM users u JOIN project_members pm ON u.user_id = pm.user_id AND pm.project_id = #{id} AND pm.is_active = 'O1' JOIN project_member_roles pmr ON pm.project_member_id = pmr.project_member_id JOIN roles r ON pmr.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.is_active = 'O1' AND r.role_name NOT IN ('총괄PL', 'PM', 'PL')

SELECT pm.user_id FROM project_members pm JOIN project_member_roles pmr ON pm.project_member_id = pmr.project_member_id JOIN roles r ON pmr.role_id = r.role_id WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND r.role_id IN (17,18,19)

SELECT AL.ACTIVITY_LOG_ID AS activityLogId, AL.TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, AL.TARGET_ID AS targetId, AL.ACTION_TYPE AS actionType, AL.ACTOR_USER_ID AS actorUserId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, AL.BEFORE_VALUE AS beforeValue, AL.AFTER_VALUE AS afterValue, TO_CHAR(AL.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, AL.PROJECT_ID AS projectId FROM ACTIVITY_LOGS AL LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = AL.ACTOR_USER_ID WHERE AL.target_id = #{id} AND AL.target_type = 'tasks' ORDER BY AL.CREATED_AT DESC
